item.title: Double entendre or mistranslation? Canada's language watchdog apologizes for Valentine's post
item.description: "We acknowledge that the post may have been interpreted in different ways, and we sincerely regret the situation," the Office of the Commissioner of Official Languages of Canada wrote.

item.description: Kamaljit Arora has already conceded that two of his children died by drowning and that he caused their deaths.

item.description: “Nothing like this has ever happened before over the three decades that Maestro SVP has been on the Main," says founder-owner Ilene Polansky.

item.description: The suspension will disrupt an average of 16 weekly flights, the airline said, including flights from Montreal–Trudeau airport.

item.title: Former SAAQ clerk arrested by Quebec’s anti-corruption commission
